Start date: 1769-05-02.  
15 weeks = 105 days.  
Add 6 days → total subtract 111 days.  
1769 is not a leap year (not divisible by 400, not divisible by 4? 1769/4=442.25 → no).  
Days in April 1769 = 30.  
Back from May 2:  
May 2 → back 1 day → May 1 → back 30 more days (April) → April 1 → back remaining 80 days.  
March has 31 days: back 31 → March 1 → back 49 more days.  
February has 28 days: back 28 → February 1 → back 21 more days.  
January has 31 days: from Jan 31 back 21 days → January 10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1769-01-10
